topics.title: Economic Systems and the Beginning of Planning

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish how capitalist, socialist and mixed economies answer what, how and for whom to produce.
Describe India's choice of a mixed economy, the Planning Commission and Mahalanobis's role in planning.

topics.title: The Goals of Five Year Plans

concepts.learning_objective: Explain growth and modernisation as goals of planning.
Explain self-reliance and equity as goals of planning and possible conflicts among goals.
Interpret India's peculiar structural change with a large service sector by 1990.
Explain the abolition of intermediaries and the incentive effect of land to the tiller.
Explain land ceiling legislation and why land reforms had limited success.
Describe the green revolution, its phases, requirements and risks.
Explain marketed surplus and its effect on food prices and procurement.
Evaluate the arguments for and against agricultural subsidies.

topics.title: Industrial Development: Public Sector, IPR 1956 and Small-Scale Industry

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the state took a leading role in industrial development.
Describe the three categories of IPR 1956 and the industrial licensing system.
Explain the definition and protection of small-scale industries.

topics.title: Trade Policy and the Effects of Policies (1950-1990)

concepts.learning_objective: Explain import substitution and protection through tariffs and quotas.
Evaluate the achievements and shortcomings of industrial and trade policies during 1950-1990.
